	exists = country

		owner = prev.country

	state = {
		owner = prev.country

	}
	aor1776_land_fort_net_protection > 0
}

aor1776_land_battle_native_can_pursuit = {
	NOR = {
		scope:character ?= {
			owner ?= {
				is_in_guerilla_war = yes
			}
		}
		aor1776_land_battle_is_panicked_retreat = yes
		aor1776_land_battle_is_controlled_retreat = yes
	}
	current_manpower > {
		value = opposite_battle_side.current_manpower
		multiply = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					opposite_battle_side = {
						aor1776_land_battle_is_panicked_retreat = yes
					}
				}
				add = 2
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					opposite_battle_side = {
						aor1776_land_battle_is_controlled_retreat = yes
					}
				}
				add = 4
			}
			else = {
				add = 10
			}
		}
	}
}

aor1776_land_battle_native_can_panicked_retreat = {
	NOR = {
		scope:character ?= {
			owner ?= {
				is_in_guerilla_war = yes
			}
		}
		aor1776_land_battle_is_controlled_retreat = yes
		opposite_battle_side = {
			aor1776_land_battle_is_panicked_retreat = yes
		}
	}
	current_manpower < {
		value = starting_manpower
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:character ?= {
					experience_level > 5
				}
			}
			multiply = 0.1
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:character ?= {
					experience_level > 4
				}
			}
			multiply = 0.2
		}
		else = {
			multiply = 0.3
		}
	}
}

aor1776_land_battle_native_can_controlled_retreat = {
	NOR = {
		scope:character ?= {
			owner ?= {
				is_in_guerilla_war = yes
			}
		}
		aor1776_land_battle_is_panicked_retreat = yes
		opposite_battle_side = {
			OR = {
				aor1776_land_battle_is_panicked_retreat = yes
				aor1776_land_battle_is_controlled_retreat = yes
			}
		}
	}
	scope:character ?= {
		experience_level > 5
	}
	current_manpower < {
		value = starting_manpower
		multiply = 0.2
	}
}
